name: List Voice ID Options
description: Retrieves a page of available voices, whose `voice_id` can be used for Voice ID fields. Lists public voices by default; set **Voice Type** to `private` to list your own cloned voices, and use **Language** and **Gender** to narrow results instead of paging through every voice. If `has_more` is true, pass `next_token` as the Token to get the next page. Example: Language `Spanish`, Gender `female` and Limit `2` returns `{"data": [{"voice_id": "voice_1", "name": "Camila", "language": "Spanish", "gender": "female"}, {"voice_id": "voice_2", "name": "Lucia", "language": "Spanish", "gender": "female"}], "has_more": true, "next_token": "abc"}`. [See the documentation](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/list-voices)
